collection.title: Volkswagen T-Cross 2018 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW T-Cross 2018 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this T-Cross which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
